note:
R36 — competition structure (Phase 1.2), static: (1) the tournament schedule tables (`championsschedule`, `spenglerschedule`,
`wcschedule`, `worldchampschedule`, `worldjuniorschedule` where present) read as round / slot templates — games per round, slot ids per
round, games per slot, pair multiplicities — and compared with the member counts of every league; (2) `stockleagues` (leagueid -> name /
artid / renderid / orderid); (3) the `conferencegroup` / `divisiongroup` ids >= 60 of `exhibitionteams` mapped to the leagues and clubs that
carry them (the "unnamed groups 77 / 78" question of P1-C). PS4 anchors 15–21 (+ the real NHL 20 install DB through the R6 helper when
available) and the gen7 anchors for the older tournament tables. Read-only.
Usage: python r36_tournament_templates_and_groups.py <out.json>
